target_customer: Homeowners in Greece (initially framed as Europe) selling, renting or buying property
problem: Real estate brokerage has very low consumer satisfaction in Europe per the launch post; HOMLI offers data driven valuation and a tech enabled brokerage, using its own capital to speed sales.
business_model: Brokerage commissions plus principal investment in properties, with free valuation tools as lead generation
product_category: Proptech, tech enabled real estate brokerage

founders.name: Antonis Mitropoulos
education: National Technical University of Athens, Master's in Computer Engineering

founders.name: Tim Ioannidis
education: National Technical University of Athens, Master's
previous_startups: Software consulting agency (co-founded, name not given)

founders.name: Nikos Legbelos
education: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, MSc Civil Engineering
founders.background_notes: Also worked as an engineer at a US firm advising nuclear plants on safety per YC page.

competitors.name: Spitogatos
competitors.what: Leading Greek real estate listings portal, with main rival XE.gr
competitors.funding_then: not stated (database lists about 1.1M, thin and unverified)

technical_complexity.rationale: Automated valuation needs property data in a market with little public pricing data, plus operational brokerage work; standard engineering otherwise.

defensibility.rationale: Valuation data could compound but listing portals and brokers could copy it; brokerage itself is easy to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Spitogatos launched a data insights business in April 2022; no source shows incumbents shutting HOMLI, which was active in 2026.

market_need_then: The founders cite the lowest consumer satisfaction of any industry for brokerage in Europe; Greek press in October 2022 describes demand for faster sales, but these are company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses thehomli.com, a prefixed .com, rather than homli.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Challenger positioning: Not a traditional real estate agency

branding.brand_signature: Not a traditional real estate agency positioning and the free online valuation tool
branding.community_and_virality: Greek press coverage (Ta Nea, October 2022) and Forbes cited on the site; no community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Greek press coverage exists, but the name resembles several similar names (Homie, Holi) and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: Modern brokerage to sell, rent and buy property across Europe (launch post)
pivots.to: Greek focused brokerage and later positioning as a fully autonomous real estate broker
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the launch post, YC tagline and Greek press, so exact timing is unknown.

outcome_analysis: HOMLI is a Greek focused tech enabled brokerage founded by three MIT trained Greek founders and entered the Greek market in 2022 with press coverage. It is active with about 20 staff, offices in Athens and Thessaloniki and a recently sold listings page. Funding is only in aggregators and the amounts conflict, so capital strength is unknown.
notes: Unverified funding: CB Insights total about 500K with YC, Liquid 2, Unpopular Ventures, Plug and Play, Socially Financed and a Convertible Note II; Extruct lists a 125K YC round in 2022; VCBacked mentions a May 2024 seed. No round recorded. Headquarters conflict between New York and Athens. Ta Nea article does not name founders. Another Greek player, Prosperty, raised 4.4M euros per a registry profile but the date is not shown so it is not listed. Completeness pass: The 2022 125K round rests on a single database (Extruct); the 2024-05 seed rests on VCBacked, with no amount and the VCBacked page not opened by this pass. CB Insights total of 500K conflicts and is not summed.
